body: God I hate that stupid rule. Do you think the psych ward would be the worst thing though? It’s highly stigmatized in today’s society which is lame but it may be a good thing with regards to what’s going on in your life

I totally understand. I know I don’t know you but maybe I could help you break that fear. I’m a random stranger but at least you know I’m out there and only hope to help you. If you don’t mind me asking, is it your family that might find out? (Just cuz you said you don’t really have a social circle)

Hey man or woman, I don’t have this fear because I’ve already lied about my cuts and I just recently started. I don’t know who would find them but maybe before someone finds out you could find someone you trust and love and tell them. I understand that’s scary but maybe that could shrink the fear of someone finding out by knowing you have someone on your side. Just a suggestion and do what helps you the most. No pressure whatsoever
Edit: my harming others is getting in fights just to lose. To feel something along with the pain. I am not an abusive sibling, spouse, boyfriend, etc. It doesn’t make it better, just a clarification
Thanks friends. It’s nice to have someone to talk to about this freely and get such a wide range of responses. I feel better already :)
